# Bounce — account brief

## Who

Bounce runs a network of luggage storage locations in cities around the world, described on its homepage as "Bounce | Luggage Storage Near You — Store your bags with Bounce" ([source](https://usebounce.com/)). Its GitHub org lists the company as Bounce at usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is in `usebounce/bounce-app` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in that repo pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 14 public repos and 96 followers ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).
- `usebounce/bounce-app` last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)).
- The App Store listing has 12,800 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)).
- There have been 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)).
- Bounce links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://usebounce.com/careers)). The evidence does not say what roles are listed there.

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@usebounce-maintainer-1), top contributor to `usebounce/bounce-app` with 118 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@usebounce-maintainer-2), 64 commits to the same repo ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.
- Maintainer Three (@usebounce-maintainer-3), 22 commits to the same repo ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.

## Why now

The repo was last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)), and the App Store listing shows 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

You have 118 commits in `bounce-app`, which builds through EAS on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)). The repo also runs its own CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the App Store listing shows 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). When you need a fix out between those releases, does it go over the air, or does it wait for the next build and review?
